arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# February 1938 expenditures
feb_1938 = 528
# January 1939 expenditures
jan_1939 = 693

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(jan_1939 - feb_1938)

# Absolute percent difference (using first value as reference)
percent_diff = (abs_diff / feb_1938) * 100

print(f'February 1938 expenditures: {feb_1938} million')
print(f'January 1939 expenditures: {jan_1939} million')
print(f'Absolute difference: {abs_diff} million')
print(f'Absolute percent difference: {percent_diff}%')
print(f'Rounded to nearest tenths: {round(percent_diff, 1)}%')
"
